items.title: 10.20 Metals ki activity series aur oxidation ki aasani (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 10.20 with Table 10.2, printed pages 236-237.

blocks.title: Activity series
blocks.text: Metals ki activity series metals ki un ki reactivity, khaas taur par electrons khone aur oxidise hone ke rujhan, ke mutabiq tarteeb hai. Yeh dar-asal reactivity series hai.

Series mein oonche metals ke standard reduction potentials zyada manfi hain, woh electrons khone aur oxidise hone ka zyada imkan rakhte hain, aur is liye reducing agents ka kaam karte hain; sab se oopar ke metals pani, oxygen aur acid se sab se zyada react karte hain. Caesium aur sodium jaise alkali metals bohat faal hain aur aasani se oxidise hote hain, pani jaise maddon se shiddat se react kar ke ions banate aur hydrogen chhorte hain. Series mein neeche ke metals, jaise noble metals gold aur silver, aasani se oxidise nahi hote; woh kam faal hain, aasani se electrons nahi khote, aur pani se react nahi karte. Sab se neeche ke metals pani, oxygen aur acid se sab se kam react karte hain. Is ke bar-aks series mein neeche ke metals ke standard reduction potentials zyada musbat hain, electrons hasil karne aur reduce hone ka zyada rujhan, to un ke ions oxidising agents ka kaam karte hain. Series mein metal ki jagah us ke oxidation ki aasani aur kul reactivity se seedha taalluq rakhti hai, jaisa Table 10.2 dikhati hai.

blocks.prompt: Wazahat karein ke activity series mein kuch oonche metals acids se hydrogen be-dakhal karte hain jabke neeche wale nahi kar sakte (exercise Q.2h), aur dilute hydrochloric acid mein iron dalne ka muadla, agar koi hai, likhein (Q.2g).
blocks.explanation: Hydrogen se ooncha metal H+/H2 se zyada manfi E standard rakhta hai, to woh hydrogen se zyada aasani se H+ ko electrons deta hai: metal oxidise aur H+ H2 mein reduce hota hai. Hydrogen se neeche metals, jaise copper, zyada musbat qeematein rakhte hain, to H+ un se electrons nahi le sakta. Iron hydrogen se ooncha hai: Fe + 2HCl se FeCl2 + H2.

items: Activity (reactivity) series: oxidation ki aasani se tarteeb; ooncha = zyada manfi E standard, taqatwar reducing agent, pani, oxygen, acid se zyada faal (Li -3.05 V, Na -2.71 V); neecha = zyada musbat, ions oxidising agents, ghair-faal (Ag +0.80 V, Au +1.50 V).
